title: Start Date of the Minimum Term — Paystride Payroll Card Program Agreement Note
content:
Under the Paystride Payroll Card Program agreement, the date the term months are served from, for the early termination fee, moves in two situations:

1. when a package change request that took effect was submitted fewer than 12 whole months before today, the term months are served from the submitted date of the most recent such request, the minimum term restarting with the package change;
2. failing that, when the program launched more than 30 calendar days after its signed date, they are served from the launch date;
3. otherwise the date does not move.

Whole months are the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's. A package change request counts only once it took effect; a scheduled, declined or withdrawn request does not move the date.

### Cases (hypothetical, today being 21 October)

| Most recent package change request that took effect | Signed date to launch date | Term months served from |
|---|---|---|
| submitted 22 October of the previous year (11 whole months back) | any | 22 October of the previous year |
| submitted 21 October of the previous year (12 whole months back) | 45 calendar days | the launch date |
| none | 31 calendar days | the launch date |
| none | 30 calendar days | the date does not move |

### Hypothetical effect

A program signed on 4 January, launched on 19 February (46 days later) and with no package change served from 19 February: on 25 November of the same year it has served 9 whole months, not 10.
